pages.text: Notebook, biology. Life is chemistry that makes copies of itself, with mistakes. The $(item)Bioreactor$() grows cultures in $(fluid)Nutrient Broth$(); the $(item)Gene Sampler$() takes a genome from any creature you can reach.

Creatures of other dimensions give $(item)Xenogenome Samples$() instead - their code is not DNA. The $(item)Gene Sequencer$() reads and writes genomes: $(item)Recombinant DNA$(), $(item)Engineered Enzymes$(), $(item)Folded Protein Crystals$().
Use on any creature to take a genome sample. Creatures from other dimensions give xenogenome samples.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
Every instruction for building one creature, in a vial.$(br2)Made in $(item)Gene Sequencer$().
A genome from a creature of another dimension. Its code is not written in DNA.$(br2)Made in $(item)Gene Sequencer$().
A double helix spliced from more than one creature.$(br2)Made in $(item)Gene Sequencer$().
